Review for Spa Shore (Dadar)
⚠️ Not recommended at all.

I had a very disappointing and unsafe experience here. During my massage, there was constant door knocking (16–17 times!), which was extremely disturbing and made me feel unsafe. Shockingly, the therapist even told me “please complain, the spa doesn’t understand there is a female client” and added that she was asked to open the door and massage. This is unacceptable and unprofessional.

I booked a 60-minute session for ₹2500, but got only around 40 minutes. The therapist had long nails which scratched and hurt me, and instead of giving a proper massage to relieve body knots, she just rubbed oil over my skin. There was no work done on face, head, or shoulders it was just legs and back rubbing.

When I raised concerns, the staff simply excused it saying, “your room was near the door, knocking keeps happening.” I found this dismissive if I am paying for a relaxing spa experience, I should not be constantly disturbed or put in an unsafe position.

They also charge upfront before the service, which is a big red flag because once you’re dissatisfied, you have no recourse. To add to the irony, the manager told me “visit again soon.” After such an experience, I definitely won’t.

Honestly, instead of wasting ₹2500 here, I would recommend calling UrbanClap or Yes Madam — you get a longer, more professional massage at home for under ₹2000 without the unsafe, unskilled experience.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Vaidehi Dande
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at JCB Prabhadevi.
I had booked a hair colouring and Botox treatment well in advance with Creative Director Natasha. Unfortunately, the service was completely unprofessional. The stylist I had specifically booked delegated almost the entire service to her assistant, who appeared to be a trainee. To make matters worse, while my hair service was being handled by the assistant, the stylist was busy getting her own hair service done. She even squeezed in a haircut for another client in between.
The so-called “experts” seemed to have very poor knowledge of the services they offer. Different stylists gave completely different opinions, which only added to the confusion and lack of confidence.
The front desk staff were rarely at their stations and seemed disengaged. Appointments were clearly overlapping, with no regard for clients’ time. The entire experience felt chaotic and poorly managed.
The final result was far below expectations. I left the salon with lighter pockets and a strong feeling of being cheated. This is honestly the worst service I have received anywhere. Even small local beauty parlours provide more attentive and professional service.
Would not recommend.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this place. From the beginning, the owner kept pushing me to order a “happy ending,” even though I clearly stated multiple times that I only wanted a normal massage.

We eventually agreed on a 45-minute oil massage. However, what I received was not what was promised. First, it wasn’t an oil massage but a cream massage. Then, after only 30 minutes, the session was suddenly finished. When I questioned this, I was told that the service included 30 minutes of massage and 15 minutes for a shower—something that was never clearly explained beforehand.

When I raised my concerns, they offered to compensate with an additional 10 minutes, but by that point I no longer felt comfortable continuing.

Overall, I feel ripped-off and would not recommend this place.
